title: AI for HR and People Processes

questions.question: Why do HR AI use cases need stricter controls?
options: They can involve personal data, fairness, employee impact, and manager accountability
questions.explanation: HR workflows often affect employees directly and require clear human accountability.

questions.question: Which signal is explicitly part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Personal data is one of the HR AI triage signals.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked HR AI triage plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact supports triage and control selection, not automated HR decisions.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: A human decision owner is required for people-related decisions.

questions.question: When should an HR AI use case require a launch gate?
options: When employee impact, personal data, and uncertainty are high
Only when the prompt is long
Only when no manager is involved
Never; HR AI is always low risk
questions.explanation: High-impact HR use cases need explicit review before rollout.

questions.question: What should communication clarify in HR AI workflows?
options: Where AI supports and where humans decide
That data sensitivity does not matter
questions.explanation: Trust depends on clear boundaries between AI support and human accountability.
